name: confluence_list_pages
description: List all pages in a Confluence space. Returns page ID, title, status, and version. Specify space key (e.g., "ENG", "SALES").

space_id.description: Space ID to list pages from

limit.description: Number of pages to return (default 25, max 100)

name: confluence_get_page
description: Get full content of a Confluence page by ID. Returns title, body content, status, version, and space info.

body_format.description: Body format to return: "storage" (HTML) or "atlas_doc_format" (ADF). Default: "storage"

name: confluence_search
description: Search Confluence pages by keyword or CQL query. Returns matching pages with ID, title, space, and content excerpt.

cql.description: CQL query string (e.g., "text ~ \"search term\"", "space = DEV AND type = page")

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 25, max 100)

name: confluence_create_page
description: Create a new Confluence page with title and content. Specify parent page ID or space key (e.g., "ENG"). Returns page ID and URL.

spaceId.description: Space ID to create the page in

body.description: Page body content in Confluence storage format (XHTML)

name: confluence_list_spaces
description: List all Confluence spaces in your instance. Returns space ID, key, name, type, and status. Use to discover documentation areas.

limit.description: Number of spaces to return (default 25, max 100)
